J.A.B.E.R.  N.D.I.S.O.R.E.
Jaber literally means “a person of beauty”: it is often used to describe females who have exceptional physical qualities that make them outstandingly attractive and deeply
pleasurable to look at. 

Ndisore means smart or fashionable. Generally used to refer to a person who is well dressed and or is very fashionable.

J.A.B.E.R  N.D.I.S.O.R.E. Is aimed to appreciate the beautiful and fashionable ladies who exude courage and confidence everyday in how they dress and how beautiful they are. No matter the body type, skin color the confidence and beauty is always and will always be appreciated.
